description:
Answer ONE question about ONE website from its own pages, with the sources the answer came from (SpiderSite research mode — a spiderSite job with mode="research").
Returns a job_id. Poll get_job_status, then read get_job_results -> data.research:
  answer               shaped by answer_schema (a string without one). null = the sources do not say it; that is an answer, not a failure.
  answer_schema_valid  false = the model's answer still broke answer_schema after one repair call; answer_schema_errors says how. The answer is still returned.
  answer_urls          {checked, ungrounded}: ungrounded lists every URL in the answer that appears on NO page read — the model wrote it, the site did not. Never quote one as a source. checked 0 = nothing to check.
  sources[]            {url, title, author, published_at, passages, cited}. author and published_at appear only when the page itself declares them.
  pages_read, pages_skipped_robots (those were NEVER fetched), pages_refused_unsafe, usage {model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens}.
discover: "single" (default) reads exactly url. "seed" reads url plus its own sitemap and links, ranked against the question, up to max_pages (default 8, max 20). "adaptive" follows the best link one page at a time until the question's words are covered.
The answer call runs on YOUR SpiderGate credential at model (default spideriq/research; your own client alias client:<brand_id>/<name> works), so the usage and the trace are yours.
Only public http(s) URLs: file: and raw: are a 422 at submit; an address that resolves to a private or reserved network fails the job with [unsafe_url]. A job that could read NO page fails with [research_no_readable_pages] and says why (robots.txt, unsafe, load failures); it is not retried.
For contact/lead extraction use scrape_website instead — research mode never writes to your CRM.

answer_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) the answer must match, e.g. {"type":"object","properties":{"tiers":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"price":{"type":"string"},"source_url":{"type":"string"}}}}}}. Add a source_url field wherever you want the page an item came from. Omit for a free-text answer. Only local $refs (#/...).

discover.description: single (default) = exactly url; seed = url + its sitemap/links ranked; adaptive = follow the best link page by page

include_pdfs.description: Read linked PDFs too (default false; up to 25 MB / 200 pages each)

max_pages.description: Most pages read for seed/adaptive (1-20, default 8). single always reads one page.

model.description: SpiderGate model or alias for the answer (default spideriq/research). Your client alias client:<brand_id>/<name> works.

question.description: The question to answer from the website (3-2000 characters)

respect_robots.description: Honour robots.txt (default true). A 5xx or unreachable robots.txt disallows the site (RFC 9309).

url.description: The page to start from — an absolute http:// or https:// URL

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: research_website
